title: DropBranchRequest
description: Which branch the mode made to delete, merged or not, once no worktree of the mode has it.

branch.description: A branch the mode made: forge/<slice>, as cut makes it, or forge/wip/<slice>/<n>, as set-aside makes it. Letters, digits and dashes after forge/, in parts split by single slashes, each starting with a letter or digit.

into.description: The branch the caller merges work into, which is never dropped. It has no .. and does not start with a dash.
